start: Workout tab, a member following a program, a routine up next today

user_sees: Title 'Workout'
Card 'Up next: <routine name>' with 'Start' and 'See exercises'
must_not: A skeleton that never ends
'Up next' naming a routine already done today

user_sees: Page titled 'Up next', the day name, '<n> exercises, pre-filled with your previous numbers.'
Each exercise with its kg to beat
must_not: '1 exercises' for one exercise
Another routine than the card named

user_sees: The live workout opens with that routine's exercises
must_not: Two workout screens stacked after a double tap
A different routine started than the one on screen

start: Workout tab, no routine up next

steps.action: Tap 'Start empty workout' (or the empty start on the tab)
user_sees: The live workout opens with the exercises of the last empty workout, or blank if none
must_not: The last routine's exercises loaded instead
A second workout made while one is open

steps.action: Tap 'Start blank' in the live workout
user_sees: The exercises are removed; an empty workout
must_not: Exercises still listed after 'Start blank'

start: Workout tab, a member who follows no program

steps.action: Open the 'Up next' page from a link or the card
user_sees: Title 'Nothing planned' and a line
Button 'Pick a program or build one' and 'Go to Workout'
must_not: An empty page with no way on

steps.action: Tap 'Pick a program or build one'
user_sees: The programs list opens
must_not: The app goes back to Workout instead

start: Workout tab, the phone cannot read today's plan (read fails after its retries)

user_sees: The card stays away; the tab reads again when the app is back in front
must_not: 'No workout planned for today' shown for a read error

user_sees: 'Couldn't load your next workout' with Try again
must_not: The words 'Nothing planned' for a failed read
An endless skeleton

steps.action: Tap Start when the start fails
user_sees: 'Couldn't start the workout' 'Please try again.'
must_not: A half-started workout left open

must_not: A 'Muscles ready today' card or a Quick workout button on the tab

steps.action: Open a saved link to the quick workout or ready page, if any

start: Workout tab with a workout in progress

user_sees: Card 'Workout in progress' with 'Resume workout' and a red 'Discard workout'
must_not: 'Up next' shown as if nothing is open

user_sees: Ask 'Discard workout?' 'Your in-progress workout will be deleted.' with 'Discard' and 'Keep'
must_not: The workout thrown away without asking

steps.action: Tap 'Keep', then finish the routine and come back
user_sees: Card 'Done: <routine>' and, when one is next, 'Start <next routine>'
must_not: The done routine offered again as up next today

start: Workout tab while editing a saved workout

user_sees: Card 'Editing a workout' 'You have unsaved changes to a saved workout.' with 'Resume editing' and 'Discard changes'
must_not: The edit shown as a new workout in progress

user_sees: Ask 'Discard changes?' 'Your edits will be thrown away. The saved workout stays as it was.'
The tab goes back to Up next
must_not: The saved workout deleted along with the edits

user_sees: The routine back exactly as it was
